# canShare

Whether the browser has a share sheet for this data: most phones and Safari do, most desktop browsers do not.

```tsx
import { canShare } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/share";
```

## Example

```tsx
const label = canShare({ url }) ? "Share" : "Copy link";
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `data` | `ShareContent` |

## Returns

`boolean`
